summary: Iteration 5 testing complete - All 3 new features working: 1) Public /temoignage page with review form, 2) Admin Devis month/year filters, 3) Projects dual visibility (show_on_home field). Fixed 2 backend bugs during testing.

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: GET /api/admin/reviews returned 500 error - MongoDB _id ObjectId not JSON serializable
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added proper formatting to exclude _id and convert dates to ISO strings

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Frontend uses 'status' param but backend expected 'status_filter' - filter not working
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Updated backend to accept both 'status' and 'status_filter' params, also added 'per_page' param support

seed_data_creation: No new seed data - Test reviews submitted during UI testing (TEST_Marie Tremblay, Test User Integration)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features fully functional: 1) /temoignage public page submits reviews to POST /api/reviews, shows success message, admin can see pending reviews in Témoignages tab with approve/reject buttons, 2) Admin Devis has year and month filters (data-testid='devis-filter-year' and 'devis-filter-month'), status filters, and count indicator, 3) Projects have dual visibility - Eye button for Inspiration, Home button for Accueil, GET /api/projects?home_only=true returns 7 projects. Previous iteration tests should still pass.

public_temoignage_page.detail: /temoignage page loads with form (name, email, project_type, star rating, comment), submit sends POST /api/reviews, shows success message 'Merci pour votre avis!'

admin_copy_review_link.detail: Admin Témoignages tab has 'Copier le lien témoignage' button (data-testid='copy-review-link-btn') and shows /temoignage URL in card

admin_pending_reviews.detail: Admin Témoignages shows 'Avis en attente' section with approve/reject buttons for pending reviews

projects_dual_visibility_api.detail: GET /api/projects?home_only=true returns only projects with show_on_home=true (7 projects), PUT /api/admin/projects/{id} with show_on_home works

projects_dual_visibility_ui.detail: Admin Projets has Eye button (toggle-visible) for Inspiration and Home button (toggle-home) for Accueil, legend explains both, 'Accueil' badge shown on home projects

home_inspiration_section.detail: Home page #inspiration section shows 7 category cards (one per category) with projects from home_only=true API call

admin_devis_filters.detail: Admin Devis has year filter (data-testid='devis-filter-year'), month filter (data-testid='devis-filter-month'), status buttons, and count indicator 'X devis affiché(s)'

api_reviews_post.detail: POST /api/reviews accepts client_name, client_email, rating (1-5), comment, project_type, returns success with review_id

api_admin_reviews.detail: GET /api/admin/reviews returns formatted reviews with proper JSON serialization (fixed _id issue)

api_admin_devis_filters.detail: GET /api/admin/devis accepts status param for filtering, returns createdAt for date filtering in frontend
